name: Harrisonburg city, VA
findings: Harrisonburg city has 205 nonprofit organizations. 104 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Harrisonburg city has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Harrisonburg city list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).
